quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Peak Owner EPS of 14.77 CHF in FY2025 reflects secular demand for HVAC damper actuators and control valves across commercial buildings and AI data centers without non-cash windfalls. Exceptional operating ROIC of 34.17% (GAAP 32.41%) on pristine zero-debt balance sheet. 5-10Y forward growth of 8.5% driven by global building decarbonization retrofits (5.0%), data center liquid cooling applications (2.0%), and mission-critical pricing power (2.0%), partially offset by ongoing R&D and footprint investments.
